summary.text: Keith Scully is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 32-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing fellow Democrat Danica Noble.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Scully said he has served ten years on the Shoreline City Council and has been a lawyer for nearly 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Keith Scully earned a high school diploma from Santa Cruz High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Los Angeles in 1993, a graduate degree from Tufts University in 1997, and a law degree from New York University in 1998.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his first career was as a paramedic in Hudson County, New Jersey.

Scully said in the survey that his legal career has included work as a King County deputy prosecutor, prosecuting war crimes for the United Nations, serving as legal director of the environmental nonprofit Futurewise, and, for the last 15 years, intellectual property litigation.
He said he has spent ten years on the Shoreline City Council.
He placed first in the August 4, 2026 primary with 26.6% of the vote.
Scully described his campaign priorities as balanced fiscal management with limits on state spending, full funding of education including special education, and progressive tax reform.
He named the environment, education and transportation as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
